comment: Revidirana AI procjena; nije drugi neovisni ljudski ocjenjivač. Pretraga lanca opisana je obrnuto: 1 je korijen, a do 10 treba proći sve čvorove; pogrešna atribucija autora ne računa se kao SM.
Preslagivanje svake police pri svakom unosu sugerira globalnu obnovu umjesto lokalnih rotacija i održavanja invarijanti.
Sigurnost tipova miješa se s vremenom provjere, a analogije sugeriraju da dinamički sustav dopušta nevaljane operacije do nastanka štete.
Konkurencija za jedan kontroler i kviz nisu dovoljan prikaz deadlocka; obična zauzetost resursa nije trajno kružno čekanje.
Pretraga u ime klijenta i samostalno praćenje preporuka pravilno su razdvojeni.
Izraz zamrzavanje sustava tumačim kao blokadu opisanog skupa sudionika, ne nužno svih procesa računala; prikazan je stvaran ciklus čekanja.
Pravilo samo nekoliko redaka preusko je: pokrivajući indeksi i indeksi izraza mogu pomoći i u isključenim slučajevima.
Ograničen broj ulaznica, čekanje i vraćanje dozvole vjerno prikazuju upravljanje kapacitetom.
Srednji položaj dopušten je pivot, ali nije medijan vrijednosti; loše podjele ipak su prepoznate.
Rast programa i dobivanje bogatijeg izlaza zamjenjuju rast ulaznih podataka i vremensko-prostorni kompromis za isti problem.
Brojanje referenci ne jamči odsutnost velikih stanki jer oslobađanje može pokrenuti veliku kaskadu.
Distance-vector može naći najkraći put bez cijele karte, a link-state izračun provodi svaki usmjerivač zasebno, ne zajednički.
Trenutačni povratak bez troška pogrešna je implikacija analogije; stvarni prijelaz zahtijeva spremanje i obnovu konteksta.
Svaki resurs u primjeru ima jednu kopiju i prikazan je zatvoren ciklus čekanja; navedeni primjer doista je deadlock.
Trajno uzajamno čekanje uz zadržavanje resursa ispravno ilustrira deadlock bez potrebe za punim formalnim popisom.
Mark-and-sweep označava dohvatljivo, ne smeće, a reference counting ne jamči da ništa nekorišteno neće ostati zbog ciklusa.
Kapacitet i veličina kutije nisu prostorna složenost kao funkcija veličine ulaza; analogija zamjenjuje sam koncept.
Precizno navedena dopuštena razlika jedan razjašnjava kasniju hiperbolu savršene ravnoteže; apsolutne usporedbe brzine neprecizne su.
Izolirani procesi i izvršavanje unutar procesa dobro su prikazani; ubrzanje je tipična mogućnost, ne univerzalno jamstvo.
Dodatna aktivnost unutar istog glazbenika prikazuje izvršavanje unutar procesa; izostavljeni memorijski detalji nisu izričito poricani.
Sugerira lokalni izbor sljedećeg susjeda umjesto globalnog minimuma udaljenosti i zabranjuje valjane bridove težine nula.
AVL smije imati razliku visina jedan, suprotno tvrdnji da se ispravlja i najmanja razlika.
Pogrešno dopušta string eksplicitnom number tipu TypeScripta, pogrešno opisuje Java broj-plus-string i izjednačuje statičko tipiziranje sa sigurnošću.
LSP ovdje čitam kao zahtjev da Cat bude zamjenjiv za Animal, ne kao tvrdnju da svako nasljeđivanje automatski jamči ugovor; formulacija je dvojbena.
Analogija pravilno razlikuje podudaranja i zadržavanje nepodudarenih sudionika s odabranih strana.
Odsutnost stanki nije zajamčena, a pseudokod dodjele može prerano osloboditi objekt kod samododjele.
Isti PUT na istom resursu daje isto stanje; nova krila prikazuju mogućnost kumulativnog učinka POST-a.
Neograničena tvrdnja da CPU može izvršavati samo jedan program zanemaruje više jezgri, premda je mehanizam spremanja i obnove dobar.
Pogrešno zabranjuje kombiniranje OR pretraga i zahtijeva silazni indeks za silazni ORDER BY; više tvrdnji o nekorištenju indeksa preopćenito je.
Uvod opisuje memoriju Java/Python objekata kao zauzetu do eksplicitnog oslobađanja, suprotno automatskom prikupljanju.
Pamćenje mjesta nastavka i izmjena pažnje prenose osnovni mehanizam bez tvrdnje da nema troška.
Vrtlar ilustrira relativnu strogoću ravnoteže; superlativ o pretrazi neprecizan je, ali ne zamjenjuje pravilo konkretnom pogrešnom invarijantom.
Četiri uvjeta i prekidanje jednog pravilno su navedeni; izraz o nedijeljenju čitam u kontekstu barem jednog isključivog resursa.
Broj nakon kose crte označava mrežne bitove, a ne broj kuća ili uređaja.
OSPF može imati prolazne petlje i ne jamči konvergenciju uvijek kraću od sekunde ili trenutačan prijelaz nakon kvara.
Real-time i stalan mali trošak nisu opće jamstvo brojanja referenci zbog mogućih kaskada oslobađanja.
Statičko tipiziranje ne uklanja sve pogreške, a dinamičko tipiziranje ne nagađa proizvoljnu namjeru poput kuhara u analogiji.
Poredak brzine previše je kategoričan; držanje za ruke prihvaćam kao nepotpunu sliku povezanosti s korijenom, ne izričitu tvrdnju o smjeru referenci.
Dijkstra dopušta nulte težine; negativni brid nije sinonim za prečac, a ograničenje nije nemogućnost kretanja unatrag.
Podudaranja i očuvanje redaka ispravno su opisani; prazno mjesto tumačim kao slikovni prikaz NULL-a, ne praznog stringa.
Označavanje zadržanih objekata i brojanje referenci do nule ispravni su; izostanak korijena i ciklusa sam po sebi nije pogreška.
Fizičko držanje svih knjiga na istoj polici nije selektivnost upita i samo po sebi ne čini indeks beskorisnim.
Brojanje do nule i uklanjanje neoznačenog dobro su razdvojeni; tranzitivna dohvatljivost izostavljena je, ali nije poricana.
Vjerojatnost najgoreg slijeda nije općenito 1/n!, median-of-three ne isključuje patološke ulaze, a rekurzijski prostor nije uvijek O(log n).
Preslagivanje po autoru ilustrira organizaciju ili indeksiranje, bez namjerne redundancije koja definira denormalizaciju.
Grupiranje je povezano s izričito navedenim dupliciranjem, dodatnim prostorom i sporijim drugim operacijama.
DELETE jest idempotentan, ponovljeni identični PUT ne stvara novo stanje svaki put, a POST može mijenjati postojeće podatke.
Repna optimizacija općenito ne daje O(1) stoga; izbor slučajnog pivota i median-of-three nisu jamstvo protiv kvadratnog vremena.
Uvjet read-heavy i upozorenje o pažljivoj primjeni ograničavaju preporuku; izraze trenutačno i mnogo brže ocjenjujem kao pretjerivanje u inače točnom prikazu.
Distance-vector ne sadrži samo izravne susjede; OSPF ima periodična osvježenja, a link-state ne isključuje prolazne petlje.
Mala tablica i ponavljanje vrijednosti nisu univerzalni razlozi beskorisnosti indeksa; ključni su selektivnost upita i trošak plana.
Brojanje referenci nije jedan prolaz; stalno ažuriranje i moguća kaskada ne dopuštaju usporedbu brzine samo brojem prolaza.
Kasniji izričiti opis dupliciranja razjašnjava početno lijepljenje kartica, pa ne zaključujem da se denormalizacija svodi na reorganizaciju.
Bankarov algoritam izbjegava nesigurna stanja, a nije postupak zahtijevanja svih resursa odjednom radi ukidanja hold-and-wait uvjeta.
CIDR bitovi i /24 primjer točni su; identifikacija uređaja početničko je skraćivanje adrese sučelja.
Kategorije igračaka i bilježaka pogrešno zamjenjuju atomarnost i pune odnosno tranzitivne funkcionalne ovisnosti.
Dijeljeni resursi i privatni kontekst dretvi razlikuju se ispravno; izjave o trošku i izolaciji uzimam kao tipične osobine.
Najviši učenik ne daje jednake skupine; najniži šalje gotovo sve u višu skupinu, a razine rekurzije nisu ukupni broj podjela.
Odgovornost za slijed upita pravilno je razdvojena; sigurnosne i izvedbene usporedbe općenite su.
Semafor nije samo broj, a odvojeno gledanje i smanjivanje bez atomarne operacije ne osiguravaju sinkronizaciju.
Odvojene trgovine i radnici sa zajedničkim resursima unutar trgovine dobro prikazuju osnovni odnos.
Kutije za igračke, dijelove i upute nisu uvjeti normalnih formi; pogrešno zamjenjuju ovisnosti i atomarnost.
Dupliciranje i dodatno održavanje točni su; kviz bez opterećenja ne omogućuje jednoznačan izbor, ali obje mogućnosti mogu biti opravdane u različitim okolnostima.
POSIX sem_wait ne zahtijeva negativan brojač; empty/full bez dodatnog isključivanja ne štite proizvoljan višestruki producer-consumer pristup spremniku.
Dretve ne dijele baš sve: svaka zadržava vlastiti stog, registre i programsko brojilo.
Spajanje Products i Prices u Items bez uvođenja redundancije ne mora biti denormalizacija.
Svi ne saznaju odmah za kvar; potrebni su detekcija, propagacija oglasa i konvergencija.
OSPF gradi kartu iz oglasa lokalnih veza, a ne cijelih karata svakog usmjerivača; RIP nije nagađanje.
Trenutačni ispravan put nakon promjene veza zanemaruje vrijeme otkrivanja i razmjene informacija.
Izravna tvrdnja o sporijem mark-and-sweep postupku previše generalizira: trošak ovisi o opterećenju, kolektoru i mjeri izvedbe.
Mrežni i host dio te odnos duljine prefiksa i veličine podmreže prikazani su ispravno; prometna korist pojednostavnjena je.
Nenegativne težine i konačnost udaljenosti pravilno su opisani; redoslijed izlaganja primjera nespretan je.
Brka vrijeme i memoriju brute-force TSP-a te O(n log n) s logaritamskim rastom; broj ukupnih poziva nije vršna memorija.
Uvijek oduzmi dvije adrese ne vrijedi univerzalno, primjerice za /31 point-to-point i /32; /24 izračun jest točan.
JOIN nije doslovni presjek ili unija skupova: povezuje stupce prema uvjetu i dopušta više podudaranja za isti redak.
Rekurzija ne jamči bržu DNS rezoluciju; razlika je odgovornost za upite, a brzina ovisi o predmemoriji i mreži.
Jedan loš pivot nije dovoljan za kvadratni slučaj; prosječno vrijeme ne zahtijeva svaku podjelu na savršene polovice.
Maska kao razdjelnica i odnos duljine prefiksa prema veličini bloka vjerno prenose osnovu CIDR-a.
Zastarjele statistike nisu zastario indeks; redovno održavanje indeksa i statistike optimizatora različite su stvari.
Podmreže unutar jedne IP adrese obrću odnos adresnog bloka i pojedinačne adrese.
Idempotentnost ne zahtijeva identične odgovore; POST nije obvezan stvoriti novi resurs svakim ponavljanjem.
Procesima upravlja OS, a postoje i korisničke dretve; kontrast jezgre za dretve i korisničkih biblioteka za procese pogrešan je.
Mala tablica i dohvat većine podataka valjani su slučajevi; pravilno korištenje indeksa ostaje nedovoljno određeno.
Analogija ključa obrće smjer LSP-a: kod za podtip ne mora prihvatiti nadtip, nego podtip mora zadovoljiti ugovor nadtipa.
Pravila slijede početničku referencu, uz pojednostavljivanje formalne uloge svih kandidatskih ključeva na primarni ključ.
Podjele i dubina rekurzije pravilno objašnjavaju prosječno O(n log n) i najgore O(n²) vrijeme.
AVL dopušta razliku visina do jedan; izričito jednake visine i savršeno ravna klackalica pogrešno definiraju uvjet.
Square u kodu nasljeđuje Shape, a ne Rectangle kako tvrdi tekst; demonstrirana povreda ugovora ne odgovara navedenoj hijerarhiji.
Dohvatljivost, ciklusi i nulti broj referenci točni su; malu latenciju tumačim kao tipično ponašanje, ne strogo jamstvo.
Označavanje smeća i uklanjanje označenog obrće mark-and-sweep: označuju se dohvatljivi, a uklanjaju neoznačeni objekti.
The example reverses the cost of search: 1 is at the root, and to reach 10 you have to go through the entire chain; I do not treat incorrect author names as SM.
A librarian who perfectly rearranges every shelf on every insertion suggests a complete rearrangement, instead of local maintenance of invariants.
Analogies equate dynamic typing with allowing invalid operations and static typing with complete safety; the time of checking is not the same as type safety.
The mutual exclusion example and the quiz confuse ordinary competition for a single resource with deadlock; merely waiting for an occupied resource is not enough.
The analogy correctly distinguishes fetching a search from following instructions to the next server.
Circular wait is well illustrated, but the claim that the entire system freezes unjustifiably extends a blockage of a set of processes to the entire system.
An index does not speed up only queries with few results: covering indexes and expression indexes are counterexamples to the claim that everything is always scanned.
The tickets faithfully represent a limited number of permits, waiting, and returning the permit; the omitted details do not change the described mechanism.
The middle position is a valid choice of pivot, but it is not the same as the mean; the explanation nevertheless recognizes the possibility of bad partitions.
Program size growth and the choice of richer output replace memory growth with input size and the time-space trade-off for the same task.
The claim that reference counting does not create large pauses ignores the cascading freeing of a large object graph.
The lack of a complete map does not mean that distance-vector cannot find shortest paths; link-state computation is performed by each router separately.
The teacher's and the task's immediate return conceals the actual time cost of saving and restoring the context.
The example with individual books shows all four conditions and a real circular wait; releasing resources breaks the blockage.
The example of keeping one's own toy with a permanent mutual wait faithfully illustrates deadlock; an incomplete list of conditions is not an error in itself.
Mark-and-sweep marks reachable objects, not garbage; the claim that reference counting leaves no unused objects ignores cycles.
The size of the box and the capacity of the container replace space complexity as a function of input size, without a correct representation of the time-space trade-off.
The precise rule allows a height difference of one; I take the expression perfectly balanced in the summary and absolute speed comparisons as imprecise shorthand.
Separate processes and execution units within a process are correctly distinguished; speedup using threads is not guaranteed for every task.
The musician and the additional activity represent execution within a process; details about shared memory are missing, but the analogy does not deny them.
The procedure suggests choosing only the neighbor of the current node instead of the globally smallest tentative distance and incorrectly excludes edges of weight zero.
An AVL may have a height difference of one; a perfectionist who corrects even the smallest difference creates a wrong invariant.
It equates static typing with safety, incorrectly allows assigning a string to an explicit number type in TypeScript, and incorrectly describes Java adding a number and a string.
Inheriting a property by itself does not guarantee LSP; substitutability is a requirement of preserving the contract, not an automatic consequence of an is-a relationship.
The dance analogy correctly distinguishes retaining matches and unmatched rows from the left, right, or both sides.
Reference counting does not guarantee the absence of pauses; the assignment pseudocode frees the old target before incrementing the new count, which is unsafe in self-assignment.
The analogies distinguish an unchanged final state from repeated addition; PUT should be read as repeating the same content on the same resource.
The unlimited claim that the CPU can execute only one program ignores multiple cores; the description of saving and restoring context is otherwise correct.
It incorrectly claims that the optimizer cannot combine OR searches and that a descending index is necessary for descending ORDER BY; several prohibitions on index use are overly general.
In the introduction, it presents Java/Python memory as occupied until explicit freeing, although automatic freeing is precisely the foundation of their GC.
Changing tasks while remembering the continuation point conveys the essence of context switching without claiming that the operation is free.
The gardener conveys the difference between stricter and looser balance maintenance; the fastest possible search is an exaggerated formulation, not a guaranteed property.
The conditions and their breaking are correctly stated; I read the formulation about not sharing resources in the context of at least one exclusive resource.
The number after the slash indicates the number of network bits, not the number of computers; Maple Street/20 directly suggests an incorrect meaning of the prefix.
OSPF is not without possible transient loops, and convergence is not guaranteed to be instantaneous or always shorter than a second.
The description of a constant small cost and real-time freeing in reference counting ignores cascades of freeing and their unbounded latency.
Static types do not remove all errors, and a dynamic system does not guess intent; the order-and-crust analogy mixes type checking with arbitrary choice.
The claim that mark-and-sweep is necessarily slower is not a general rule, and holding hands suggests undirected connection instead of directed reachability from roots.
Dijkstra allows zero weights; negative weights are not a synonym for shortcuts, and the restriction is not an inability to move backward.
Matches and the retention of unmatched rows are accurately shown; I interpret the empty place as a simplified representation of NULL, not as an empty string.
Counting pointers to zero and removing unmarked objects are correctly stated; details of roots and cycles are omitted without explicit denial.
All books on one shelf is not the same as low query selectivity; even within such a group, an index can efficiently find a rare value.
Marking retained objects and freeing at zero are correctly distinguished; I treat the lack of explicit transitive reachability as an omitted detail.
The probability of the worst sequence is not generally 1/n!, median-of-three does not exclude pathological inputs, and recursion space is not always O(log n).
Rearranging books by author describes a change of organization/indexing, not the deliberate introduction of redundant data that defines denormalization.
Grouping data is connected with explicitly mentioned duplication, additional space, and slower other operations; the analogy is rough, but does not deny redundancy.
DELETE is idempotent, a repeated identical PUT does not produce a new state each time, and POST may also process or modify existing data.
Tail recursion optimization generally does not reduce Quicksort to O(1) because of that; randomization and median-of-three do not guarantee avoiding the quadratic worst case.
It presents the removal of joins as automatically faster and instantaneous reading; the advantage of denormalization depends on the specific query and measured cost.
Distance-vector is not just a list of direct neighbors, OSPF also sends periodic refreshes, and link-state does not exclude all transient loops.
A small table or repeated values are not sufficient for an index to always be useless; the selectivity of the specific query and the cost of the plan matter.
Reference counting is not a single-pass algorithm; it updates counters during execution and can cascade-free objects, so comparing speed by number of passes is not valid.
The second paragraph explicitly states duplication for faster reading and additional work with copies, which clarifies the initial gluing of cards.
The banker's algorithm serves to avoid unsafe states, and is not an example of requesting all resources at once in order to break the hold-and-wait condition.
The CIDR number of bits and the /24 example are correct; I read the device address as beginner shorthand for the address of a network interface.
Sorting toys and notebooks does not represent atomicity, full functional dependencies, and removal of transitive dependencies; the rules of normal forms are incorrectly replaced.
It correctly distinguishes the isolated address space of a process from shared resources and the separate context of threads; cost and isolation estimates are typical, not absolute.

The tallest student does not give a balanced split, and when choosing the shortest, almost all the others go into the higher group; it also confuses the number of levels with the total number of splits.
The difference in responsibility for finding the answer is correct; the description of efficiency and safety is general, but does not change the resolution mechanism.
A semaphore is not just a number, nor is synchronization just obedience to a number; viewing the number and decrementing separately without an atomic acquire is not safe synchronization.
Separate stores and workers sharing common resources correctly convey the basic difference between processes and threads.
Toy boxes, parts, and instructions are arbitrarily identified with 1NF, 2NF, and 3NF, instead of representing their different conditions about values and dependencies.
Copying for fewer joins and additional work on changes are correctly described; the quiz does not provide enough workload for an unambiguous choice.
POSIX sem_wait does not require a negative counter, and two empty/full semaphores do not guarantee mutual exclusion with multiple producers or consumers.
The claim that threads share absolutely everything erases their separate stack, registers, and program counter; a shared kitchen alone does not show that boundary.
Merging the Products and Prices tables into Items is not necessarily denormalization: without introduced redundancy, the result can remain normalized.
The claim that all routers immediately learn about a closed road removes change detection, LSA message transmission, and convergence time.
OSPF does not receive the whole map from every router but advertisements of local links; RIP is not guessing but a distributed distance computation.
The analogy promises an immediately correct path even when links change, without time for detecting the change and exchanging information.
The general claim that mark-and-sweep is slower replaces the cost-latency trade-off with a universal speed ordering; the mechanisms are otherwise faithfully presented.
The mask as a divider and the relationship of prefix length to subnet size are accurately shown; claims about traffic are simplified.
Zero weights and the reason for the finiteness of distance are correctly stated; the awkward order of presenting the example does not change the presented counterexample.
It confuses the time and memory of brute-force TSP and describes O(n log n) as logarithmic memory growth; the number of total recursive calls is not peak occupied memory.
The rule always subtract two addresses is not universal: /31 point-to-point and /32 have special semantics, although the /24 example is correct.
Identifying INNER/FULL JOIN with set intersection/union ignores column joining, the match condition, and multiple matches in SQL.
Recursive resolution is not necessarily faster; the difference is who follows queries and recommendations, and speed depends on cache and network.
One bad pivot choice does not by itself create a quadratic case; the analogy of the average case with constant perfect halving is also too narrow.
The network-host divider and the relationship of short and long prefixes to block size are accurately shown.
Outdated statistics are not an outdated or unmaintained index; indexes are maintained on writes, and statistics affect plan choice, not index validity.
Floors as subnets within a single IP address suggest the opposite relationship: a subnet is a block of addresses, and an individual address is not a container of subnets.
Idempotency means the same intended effect on state, not necessarily the same response; POST is not obliged to create a new resource on every repetition.
It incorrectly contrasts thread management in the kernel with process management in user libraries; user threads also exist, and processes are managed by the OS.
A small table and retrieving most of the data are valid reasons for scanning; the expression proper use of an index is imprecise, but is not a new algorithmic requirement.

The key analogy reverses the direction of LSP: code that requests a subtype does not have to accept a supertype, rather the subtype must fulfill the contract that the client expects from the supertype.
The introductory rules of normal forms and the trade-offs correspond to the reference description; formulations about only the primary key simplify the formal role of candidate keys.
It correctly connects the levels of recursion and partition sizes with average O(n log n) and worst O(n²), without a guarantee of perfect balance.
AVL requires a height difference of at most one, not exactly equal heights; the analogy of a perfectly level seesaw directly confirms the wrong rule.

The text claims that Square inherits Rectangle, but the code inherits Shape; the example therefore does not implement the stated hierarchy, although it illustrates the violation of the setter contract well.
Reachability, cycles, and zero reference count are correctly separated; I read the claims about low latency as typical behavior, not a strict guarantee.
The janitor marks garbage and removes what is marked, which reverses mark-and-sweep: reachable objects are marked, and unmarked ones are removed.
